Your impact begins here

As Administrative Assistant, you will help 7 leaders and their departments across DPM Excellence Quality work from the same page. You will coordinate shared activities, communication and routines, and turn everyday administration into clear and simple ways of working. Your support gives leaders and colleagues the time and clarity to focus and stay in control.

What you’ll bring

You are structured, service-minded and good at seeing what the people around you will need next. You bring:

· An administrative education, or equivalent relevant work experience.

· At least 2 years of relevant work experience.

· Spoken and written English.

· A proactive mindset: you anticipate shared needs, deadlines and dependencies across sev-eral departments.

· The ability to stay organised and balance requests and priorities, working independently and using sound judgement.

· Strong communication and stakeholder management skills, and the ability to create align-ment across organisational boundaries.

· An approachable, service-minded way of supporting leaders and employees, with strong at-tention to detail and quality.

· A flexible, practical approach that helps you find ways forward in a changing environment.

Essential:

Experienced with Coupa, SAP, and Microsoft 365, including Teams and SharePoint.

What you’ll do

You will be a central point of contact for leaders and employees across the supported depart-ments, creating overview and consistency where work crosses team lines. This role does not in-clude personal assistant responsibilities or individual calendar and inbox management.

· Provide structured administrative and operational support to 7 leaders, coordinating com-mon activities, priorities and deliverables, and keeping an overview of deadlines, dependen-cies and recurring activities.

· Coordinate meetings, workshops, seminars, off-sites and social activities, and support practi-cal needs such as access, equipment, meeting rooms and relocations.

· Maintain distribution lists, Teams and SharePoint sites, organisational overviews and shared documentation.

· Draft and coordinate announcements, management communication and updates on organi-sational changes, and prepare and quality-check presentations, organisational charts and workshop material.

· Support financial follow-up, including purchase orders in Coupa, invoice handling, cost allo-cation and vendor dialogue.

· Develop common routines, templates, trackers and governance structures, and look for ways to standardise and simplify how the area works.

· Contribute to cross-departmental projects and provide flexible support during peak periods and organisational changes.

Who you’ll work with

You’ll join Compliance & Improvement department in DPM Excellence Quality and work closely with the leaders across DPM Excellence Quality.

You’ll partner with internal functions and external suppliers, and share best practices through eg administrative networks.

The role is based in Lyngby and reports to Maria Lasaki, Associate Director, Compliance & Improvement.

What you can expect here

You will have room to take initiative. If guidance does not exist, you will work with the leader-ship team to set up the systems and routines the departments need.

You will keep building your knowledge of tools, systems and administrative processes, and learn from colleagues through administrative networks. You will be trusted to prioritise, make your voice heard and make a visible difference to how several departments work together.

Salary: The Annual Base Salary ranges from 437,600.00 to 643,200.00 DKK, corresponding to the level of the position.

The placement within the salary range will be assessed during the recruitment process based on the candidate’s skills, competencies, knowledge, and relevant experience.

Incentives and Benefits: The salary package may include short-term and/or long-term incen-tives as well as other employee benefits based on position level, location, functional area and relevant market benchmarks. Learn more about our Reward Philosophy here

Start now

Your impact begins today. If you are ready to bring clarity and momentum to how seven departments work together, apply for the Administrative Assistant role by 1 December 2026. Applications are reviewed on an ongoing basis, so we encourage you to apply as soon as possible.

For further information, please contact Maria Lasaki at xmlz@novonordisk.com

We commit to an inclusive recruitment process and equality of opportunity for all our job applicants.

**_Help customers turn technology into solutions they use every day.

_**At Trackunit, our IrisX industry cloud platform unlocks insights, benchmarks, and innovation through connected construction data. As a Solution Delivery Engineer, you’ll help customers successfully implement and adopt Manager and IrisX, making these platforms part of their everyday operations.

This is a hands-on role at the intersection of engineering, data, and customer engagement. You’ll configure solutions, build integrations, and work with customer teams to translate their needs into practical results. Along the way, you’ll collaborate with colleagues across Trackunit and explore a wide range of technologies and customer environments.

****What’s in it for you

******A broad technical playground

**You’ll work across platform configuration, software development, integrations, and data engineering. Depending on the project, you could use Python and SQL, JavaScript or TypeScript, REST and GraphQL APIs, webhooks and Databricks. There’s room to apply your strengths while building experience in new areas.

**Customer projects with tangible outcomes

**Your work will help construction companies connect their systems, improve their data, and adopt new ways of working. You’ll see solutions through to practical use and understand how your contribution helps customers get more value from Trackunit.

**Collaboration across disciplines

**You’ll work closely with Solution Delivery colleagues, Sales Engineering, IoT Services, Customer Success, Product, and Engineering. You’ll have opportunities to learn from different specialisms, share your knowledge, and contribute customer insights that help improve our platforms.

**Ownership and professional growth

**You’ll take responsibility for meaningful parts of customer delivery, with scope reflecting your experience and strengths. Whether you want to deepen your technical expertise, develop your customer-facing skills, or take on more complex implementations, you’ll have opportunities to grow through practical work, coaching, and feedback.

**The Opportunity To Shape How We Deliver

**Beyond individual projects, you’ll help develop reusable solutions, implementation patterns, and documentation. Your ideas and experience will contribute to making future deliveries more effective across the global Solution Delivery team.

**An international and flexible workplace

**You’ll join a global team that values collaboration, knowledge sharing, and personal development, with a flexible working setup and connections across teams and borders.

****What you’ll work on

******Solution implementation and adoption

**Configure, extend, test, and deploy Manager and IrisX solutions to fit customer workflows and help customers put them into use.

**Integrations and data pipelines

**Connect Trackunit with customer systems such as ERP, CRM, and fleet management tools through APIs, webhooks, and data flows, supporting reliable and secure data exchange.

**Applied data and analytics

**Turn connected construction data into useful insights, supporting use cases such as equipment fault analysis, benchmarking, and emissions reporting, and other customer-specific analytics use cases.

**Customer enablement

**Work with customer teams through technical workshops, training, and implementation support, helping them confidently operate and adopt the solutions delivered.

**Coordinated delivery and continuous improvement

**Collaborate with internal teams and customer stakeholders on implementation activities and clear handovers. Share delivery learnings and customer feedback with Product and Engineering to improve the platform and future deployments.

**Bring your curiosity and perspective

**There are different paths into Solution Delivery. Your experience might come from software engineering, data, integrations, technical consulting, or practical projects that you’re ready to build on.

You don’t need to know every technology we use. We’re interested in how you approach problems, collaborate with others, and connect technical work with customer needs.

If you enjoy building solutions and helping people put them to work, we’d love to hear from you.

**Our hiring process

**Don’t waste your time writing the perfect cover letter. We want you to create an impact that matters - and that’s not in the cover letter.

• Initial phone conversation with a colleague from our P&T team.

• Virtual meet and greet with your potential new leader and someone from the team, so you’ll get to know the role and team better.

• Virtual second interview / in-person with the hiring manager and the team.

• Assignment-specific interview with the hiring manager and a peer from the team. We want to give you a real insight into the work. You’ll receive a case to prepare ahead of the interview and present to relevant colleagues - people you’ll also work closely with in the role.

• If needed, we will obtain references from former employers and conduct background checks at relevant levels.

• Offer presentation and walk-through.

**Coming Together To Connect Construction

**We’re committed to construction - one of the largest industries in the world. Over the past two decades, Trackunit has been pioneering technological progress within construction. Today, we are not only a leading IoT provider but a thought leader, supporting and shaping the agenda for an entire industry on a global scale.

We believe in taking a people approach in everything we do. Being human-centric is not restricted to our products - it’s a way of life at Trackunit. We’re proud to be a truly global team. Our colleagues come together in hubs spread across the globe, but we embrace the idea of working remotely and in environments that inspire you. Everything we do, we do to eliminate downtime and build the most useful industry for the world.

The question is: Are you in?

If you’re energized by quality, validation, and complex Automation and IT projects in pharma engineering, we’d love to hear from you!

**Who We Are

**We are a leading pharma engineering company shaping the future of API pharma engineering globally. Leveraging the expertise of 2,000+ employees across Denmark, India, and the US, we design, build and optimise pharmaceutical manufacturing facilities that are essential to the health and well-being of patients everywhere.

Our success is driven by passion, innovation, and collaboration — with our customers and across our teams and disciplines. If you share our dedication to a noble cause and our passion for API pharma engineering, then NNE is the place for you.

**About The Role

**We are looking for an AIT Quality Engineer to join our AIT Project Quality Management team. In this role, you will be responsible for planning, driving, and delivering validation and quality activities within complex Automation and IT projects in the pharmaceutical and life science industry.

You will work as part of multidisciplinary project teams and act as a trusted advisor on validation strategy, GMP compliance, quality risk management, and project quality execution from project initiation through to handover. The role combines hands-on technical validation expertise with project quality management responsibilities, ensuring that deliverables, quality expectations, timelines, and customer requirements are aligned throughout the project lifecycle.

Location Denmark - Kalundborg

Experience Minimum 5 Years

Department AIT Project Quality Management

**How You Might Spend Your Days

**As an AIT Quality Engineer, you’ll be:

• Leading CQV and validation activities for automation, IT, computerized systems, and equipment interfaces in GMP-regulated projects.

• Developing and reviewing validation documentation, including URS, FS/DS, SVP, IQ/OQ/PQ, risk assessments, test protocols, and summary reports.

• Executing qualification and testing activities while ensuring compliance with GMP requirements, industry standards, and customer expectations.

• Collaborating with customers, suppliers, and project teams throughout FAT, SAT, commissioning, validation, and handover.

• Managing validation risks, deviations, compliance issues, and mitigation actions across projects.

**Who You Are

**We care about who you are as a person. In the end, how you work, and your energy is what impacts the results we achieve as a team. As a person, you are:

• Able to work independently while building strong relationships with stakeholders.

• Comfortable balancing compliance, quality, timelines, and project risks.

• Eager to share knowledge and support the development of colleagues.

• Skilled at communicating complex validation topics in a practical way.

• Motivated by collaboration and delivering high-quality results in project environments.

**What You Bring To The Role

**In all positions, there are some things that are preferred, and others, a bonus. If you do not meet all the qualifications listed below, you are welcome to offer alternative experience that you think would be valuable in this role:

• A B.Sc., M.Sc., or equivalent degree in engineering, IT, life sciences, biotechnology, pharmaceutical sciences, or a related field.

• Experience within CQV, validation, GMP, QA, or project quality management in the pharmaceutical, biotech, or life science industry.

• Hands-on experience preparing and reviewing validation documentation, including URS, FS/DS, SVP, IQ/OQ/PQ, risk assessments, and test protocols.

• Knowledge of GMP, GAMP 5, ISPE guidance, data integrity, quality risk management, and validation lifecycle management.

• Ability to advise customers and project teams on validation strategy, compliance risks, and quality-related decisions.

**Life at NNE

**NNE is short for Novo Nordisk Engineering. And for all of us who work here, NNE means so much more.

At NNE, you become part of a vibrant, project-based environment built on close day-to-day collaboration. The role is therefore primarily on-site, with physical presence at the workplace expected five days a week. Limited flexibility for occasional remote work may be accommodated in line with business needs.

We are, at our core, a people business and, as such, committed to continuously developing our people and the way we work together. We do not expect you to know it all from day one, and we truly believe a great start makes a real difference. We therefore welcome new colleagues with our award-nominated onboarding programme, supported by a range of in-house talent and development initiatives designed to support your long-term growth.

You can read more about the benefits we offer **here .

****Did we spark your curiosity? If you’re ready to join our passion, let’s hear from you.

****Deadline of application is 27th November 2026

**Questions before applying? Send us a quick text to arrange a convenient time to chat. Contact Manager Rebecca Larsen at +45 31 91 88 47.

**Please note:

**

• We only accept applications submitted through our online recruitment system

• You do not need to attach a cover letter, but please include a few sentences about why you are applying in your resume or CV

• We invite to interviews on a running basis.

**Fair hiring:

**At NNE, we are committed to an inclusive recruitment process and equal opportunities for all job applicants. To maintain fairness, we request that you refrain from including a personal photo in your CV.

**Still searching for the right opportunity?

**If this position isn’t quite what you're looking for, but you know someone who would excel in this role, please share this job post. And don’t forget to explore our other exciting opportunities — your future role at NNE might be just around the corner! Visit our Career Site

jobs.occupation: Head Chef for a New Italian Restaurant in Esbjerg
jobs.description:
Head Chef for a New Italian Restaurant in Esbjerg

We’re opening an Italian restaurant in Esbjerg and looking for a Head Chef to lead our kitchen team of six. You’ll join us before opening, with a chance to shape the menu, organise the kitchen and build a team that works well together.

We want to keep the menu small and give each dish the attention it deserves. You’ll develop a focused selection of Italian dishes that make the most of seasonal ingredients. Alongside it, you’ll work with our pizza chefs on a dedicated Neapolitan pizza menu.

Your responsibilities

• 
Menu development. Create and test dishes, write recipes and help the team deliver consistent quality across every service.

• 
Team leadership and rotas. Plan shifts for the six-person team, assign responsibilities and make time to train and support your chefs.

• 
Daily service. Organise prep, cook alongside the team and keep service running smoothly when the restaurant is full.

• 
Kitchen finances. Cost dishes and work closely with management to keep track of food costs, labour hours and waste.

• 
Purchasing and food safety. Place orders, work with suppliers, manage stock and oversee food safety procedures.

About you

You have hands-on experience cooking Italian food and have led a kitchen team as a Head Chef or Sous Chef. You know how to turn an idea into a dish that tastes great, works during a busy service and meets its target food cost.

You give clear direction and lead by example. You notice when a colleague needs a hand, and you keep communication calm and respectful, even when the orders come in thick and fast.

What we offer

You’ll have a say in the first menu, how the kitchen is organised and how the team works together. You’ll work directly with management, with room to put your ideas into practice. Salary will reflect your experience and qualifications.

This is a full-time position with morning, lunch, evening and weekend shifts. The start date is flexible.

Interested in leading the kitchen? Apply through this listing with your CV and a few lines about your experience with Italian cooking and kitchen leadership.

To succeed here you need a deep understanding of the creator landscape in Norway and Sweden, an instinct for what resonates online and the ability to turn trends and cultural insight into work that feels authentic, bold and social first. It's ok to be chronically online.

About ALK

ALK is a global pharmaceutical company specializing in allergy immunotherapy. We are driven by a high level of professionalism, integrity, an open-minded approach and contributing to an inspiring and fun working environment together with our colleagues. •

• 
Excellent collaboration and communication skills, with the ability to partner effectively across departments.

• 
Fluent written and spoken English.

Become a part of ALK

ALK provides a dynamic and accommodating work environment, complete with inspiring and challenging assignments. You are able to actively influence and challenge the status quo. Our flat structures attract independent individuals who like to feel the progress of the business and enjoy being close to the decision-making process. We consider our pioneering spirit, coupled with our trustworthiness, our winning formula.

Our offices in Denmark offer a green view of the DTU Science Park in Hørsholm. We believe that physical presence enforces strong teamwork and collaboration and creates success, so it is important that you enjoy coming to work at our site with a degree of flexibility to also work from home.
